name: _summer
source: Takumi Kaizu is a normal high school student enjoying his school life with his friends. Over the years, he has made good memories with these friends of his, most of whom are girls, though apparently still have no overt feelings of attraction towards any of them. When asked by his best male friend Osamu Funada if he likes anyone, Takumi starts to think about it though is still confused on what to do next. Takumi decides to find someone to like while summer vacation enters.
translation: 海津匠是一名普通高中生，与朋友们一同享受校园生活。多年来，他和这些朋友留下了许多美好回忆。朋友中大多是女生，可他似乎从未对任何人产生明确的爱慕之情。男性好友船田治问他有没有喜欢的人后，匠开始认真思考这个问题，却依旧不知道该怎样迈出下一步。随着暑假来临，他决定寻找一个能让自己真正喜欢上的人。
